Family Rook — final audit & reference build

6 Oct 2026 · Rook (home server) · Everything below was tested on the live system unless marked simulated.

PASS (with 1 planned gap)
Live acceptance 18/18 · simulated failure tests 97/97 · Yukiteru full suite 10,611 passed / 0 failed · hub suite 244 passed
Family members sign in with a PIN, type anything, and Rook picks the model level, escalates once if needed, and returns a private answer. Admins (you, Ben) keep every advanced control. The planned gap: Claude as the last rung is designed but not switched on (see "Needs you").

TestWhat was checkedResult

Why this is enough: one live check per access rule and per routing path, and simulation only for failures that would disrupt the household if forced live. The full code suites cover the edge cases.

Problems found in the audit, and fixed

#FoundFix
1Some admin tools on the home network didn't ask for a loginLocked behind an admin login + network rules
2Standard users had a chat path to Ben's admin agent (openclaw_admin)Members now have [ollama, claude] only
3Members saw the whole admin cockpitMember mode: only Agents + Family assistant
4Every family request failed (Ben's relay dropped two headers)Relay patch
5Everything went to one fixed modelAutomatic levels + one-step escalation/fallback, no request cap
6Ollama had lost the GPUs: every model on CPU (3 tok/s)Restarted (27 tok/s, 8×) + a watchdog that re-checks every 5 min
7The heavy model (27B) didn't fit the GPUsHeavy = 14B with a bigger budget; 27B removed
8The 4-digit PINs were rejected by the new hub; Sebastian/Yuko had no accountsRandom 8-digit PINs for all 5 (stored privately); both accounts created
